title: Israel strikes Hamas leaders in Doha, Qatar
body:
On Tuesday 9 September 2025, Israel struck a location in Doha, the capital of Qatar, where Hamas leaders were meeting. The Israeli military said it had conducted a precise strike targeting the senior leadership of Hamas, and later told CBS News the operation was called Summit of Fire. Al Jazeera reported the meeting was being held to discuss a US ceasefire proposal. Hamas said five of its members were killed and that Israel failed to kill its negotiating delegation. Hamas also said a member of Qatar's Internal Security was killed. These casualty claims were not independently confirmed in the report.

Qatar's government called the strike a cowardly attack, and Foreign Ministry spokesperson Majed Al Ansari described it as a blatant violation of international law. Netanyahu's office called it a wholly independent Israeli operation for which Israel took full responsibility. President Donald Trump said on Truth Social that the decision was Netanyahu's, not his, and that he had assured Qatar's emir such an attack would not happen again on Qatari soil. The United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Egypt and Turkey condemned the strike.

Accounts of advance warning conflicted. A senior US official said Israel notified Washington as the attack was about to happen, while two other US officials said the United States did not coordinate on planning. Qatar's Foreign Ministry said claims that it was warned in advance were false. Qatar hosts the largest US military base in the Middle East and had been mediating ceasefire talks with the United States and Egypt. A group representing hostage families demanded a plan to return all 48 hostages remaining in Gaza, of whom Netanyahu said about 20 were believed alive.
